messages:

Cc: procurement@onpointsys.com
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OnPoint - onboarding packet

Hi Rafael —

Attached are the documents you requested to start the vendor onboarding: Certificate of Insurance (COI), a completed W-9, and our preferred PO template. Please confirm everything looks in order or let me know if you need different wording on the additional insured endorsement.

Files attached: [Attachment: OnPoint_COI_2028-03.pdf (PDF, 128KB)], [Attachment: OnPoint_W9_2028-03.pdf (PDF, 42KB)], [Attachment: PO-Template_OnPoint.docx (DOCX, 24KB)]

OnPoint Systems

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@onpointsys.com>, procurement@onpointsys.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: OnPoint Systems COI, W-9, and PO setup

Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Quick notes from procurement review:
- COI shows general liability and professional liability limits OK; we need an additional insured endorsement on the general liability naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as additional insured (we can accept CG 20 10 or equivalent).
- Certificate expiration dates look fine.
- W-9 is intact.
- Your PO template looks standard; procurement will create our side of the PO but we need your vendor legal name and payment remit address populated exactly as on the W-9.

Two asks:
1) Can you send a short endorsed COI or endorsement page that specifically adds Redwood as additional insured?
2) Please confirm the remit address for PO/invoice routing (line-item preferred).

Looping in Marissa (finance) and Monica (vendor risk) to expedite. If you can get the endorsement by end of day tomorrow we can queue the PO.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@onpointsys.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: OnPoint Systems COI, W-9, and PO setup

Hi Elena —

Following Rafael's note, a couple of small risk items for clarity:
- Please include the policy number and insurer contact in the endorsement page. Our intake system flags policies without insurer contact info and that delays activation.
- If OnPoint uses any subcontractors who will access Redwood systems or customer data, please send a subcontractor list or confirm none will be used.

Example endorsement language we accept: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, agents and employees are named as Additional Insured, but only with respect to liability arising out of the operations of the named insured." If your broker prefers different wording, send the broker's proposed endorsement and we'll review.

Thanks — Monica
Vendor Risk Specialist

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@onpointsys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@onpointsys.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: OnPoint Systems COI, W-9, and PO setup

Monica / Rafael —

Appreciate the examples and checklist. I attached an endorsement page our broker produced that names Redwood Inference, Inc. as additional insured and includes insurer contact. I also confirmed we have no subcontractors for this engagement — all delivery is handled by OnPoint staff.

Attached: [Attachment: OnPoint_Endorsement_2028-03.pdf (PDF, 64KB)]

Remit address for invoices (as on the W-9):
OnPoint Systems
Accounts Receivable
1127 Harbor Drive, Suite 200
San Diego, CA 92101

If that looks good I'll mark the PO template as acknowledged and send the signed onboarding forms.

Best,
Elena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@onpointsys.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: OnPoint Systems COI, W-9, and PO setup

Hi Elena —

Thanks, this is great and the endorsement page satisfies the additional insured requirement. Policy contact is present and the broker signature looks valid. Next steps from finance/procurement:
- Dylan will create and issue Redwood PO OP-2028-893 to match the remit address and payment terms (Net 30) you confirmed. Expect the doc in the next 24–48 hours.
- Please sign and return the onboarding forms linked here: https://docs.redwood.com/onboarding/onpoint-checklist (I see you started them; just need final signature).
- Once signed PO is issued and we have the endorsed COI and W-9 on file, we'll move to active vendor status so payments can be processed.

Dylan — assigning to you for PO issuance.

Elena — welcome aboard, looking forward to getting the platform connected.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
